content: {"summary":"A retry storm can be distinguished from a plain slow dependency by looking at the timing and amplification patterns: latency keeps rising after the original slowdown ends, bottom‑layer request volume exceeds top‑layer volume, and error codes (CPX‑W429) appear before or together with edge 504s. In a plain slow dependency the latency increase is proportional across hops and does not generate extra amplified traffic after the root cause subsides.","likely_cause":"Stacked retries across orders‑api and payments‑api amplified the processor’s rate‑limit back‑pressure, creating a retry storm that produced the 504s.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Latency that keeps climbing after the cause is gone, plus more requests at the bottom than at the top, signals a retry storm.","evidence_ids":["RB-016#1"],"quote":"latency that keeps climbing after the cause is gone, plus more requests at the bottom than at the top."},{"text":"If edge 504s start first and 429s appear later, our own retry traffic likely caused the 429s; if 429s lead, the processor is pushing back.","evidence_ids":["RB-016#3"],"quote":"If edge `504`s started first and the 429s only came later, our own retry traffic probably caused the 429s"},{"text":"Concurrent rises of CPX‑W429 on the proxy and PAYAPI‑E1107 on payments‑api indicate the processor is the bottleneck.","evidence_ids":["RB-016#3","INC-0162#1"],"quote":"CPX‑W429 and PAYAPI‑E1107 rise together on payments‑api"},{"text":"Setting CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1 in payments‑api stopped the amplified traffic and the edge 504s resolved within minutes.","evidence_ids":["RB-016#4","INC-0162#2"],"quote":"Within minutes the `CPX‑W429` and `PAYAPI‑E1107` volume fell and the edge stopped returning `504`"}],"next_checks":["Check the timestamp order of edge 504s versus CPX‑W429 errors to see which appears first.","Compare request counts per hop to see if bottom‑layer traffic exceeds top‑layer traffic.","Monitor per‑hop latency ratios; a rising bottom‑to‑top ratio suggests a retry storm.","Verify the current attempt settings (CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS) for each service."]}
